caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary methods state all SAMPs were synthesized with C-terminal amidation; one-letter sequence strings are not silently normalized to include that chemistry.
DBAASP antibiofilm/hemolysis/cytotoxicity exact percentages were retained as source_conflict unless they matched source text/table values.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local XML/PDF/DOCX text and captions support semiquantitative biofilm, cytotoxicity, and hemolysis conclusions, but exact per-bar numeric values in figure panels are not present as parser-supported text or tables. The review therefore preserves database exact/rounded figure-derived values as source_conflict instead of fabricating primary-source rows.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No Table 2/Table 3 MIC/MBC values are missing. Figure-only exact percentages are not used for publication-grade primary activity rows; source-supported aggregate toxicity/biofilm statements remain recorded with cautions.
